registered_before: both runs are only planned; no data of either exists. Overhead of the token probe: token-probe-overhead-v1 and its amendments
owner_decisions: 01/11: the ML is developed first and decided before any rule (tripwire, novelty, votes); then a comparison without and with rules
01/11: the replica gate (peer evidence discount) is removed from the ML
06/11: the token probe uses select1f with the futex exit hook; overhead is measured and reported, not a pass/fail limit

system.ml: lidds-ml-v3 (sentinel_pulse/protocol/lidds-ml-v3.json) on the cluster: token branch (sentinel_pulse/detector/token_model.py, per-workload model learnt from the cluster's own normal) + reference tree + support of the frozen candidate; one window above any branch's threshold fires
system.probe: make tokens build, loader --tokens grams --token-exit sys_exit, proof by scripts/token_probe_proof.py on every worker, bound to its kernel and artifact hashes
system.tree_support_model: pulse-next-run-model/model-bundle (CANDIDATE_MANIFEST sha256 4bad16dcd88b004f55d81c1a9721b9224a55b7a2cc2f35023cf57c8bb11d7fbc), the model of pulse-final-system-confirm; its preview policy is replaced by the v3 count branches (worker cfg v3_counts) and kept beside it as policy_alert_preview
system.preview_policy_file: sentinel_pulse/protocol/policy-1win-a3.json (no evidence discount, hence no peer exchange); required by the worker, its alarm is not an arm here
system.rules: none: tripwire A1 off; the comparison with rules is a later step

stage_1_capture.what: normal traffic only (matched traffic schedule), no attack campaign, 12 h, token build on the three workers, decisions of the frozen tree/support scored as usual
stage_1_capture.spans: training = the first 8 h after the traffic schedule starts; validation = the last 4 h
fit: alpha 0.0002 and the per-branch alpha / 3 are lidds-ml-v3's; the 60 s block is the design report's example, fixed here before any data
stage_1_capture.reported: token windows per workload, events and distinct grams per window, tokens.jsonl bytes per hour, drain time, insert and dentry-walk failures, validation blocks above each threshold (expected about alpha / 3 per block if the fit holds)
stage_1_capture.frozen_after: MODELS.json and the count-threshold file are written once, their sha256 enter the stage-2 plan; nothing is refitted after stage 2 starts

stage_2_live.campaign: as pulse-final-system-confirm: 21 workloads x 5 scenarios x attack rates 1, 3, 6, 12, 24 per second, 525 trials, each idle control (15 s) -> benign exec from its own file name (15 s) -> attack (15 s) on one container; fresh campaign on fresh traffic, 24 h

arms.V3: candidate_alert_preview of the count decisions (v3 tree or support) or of the token decisions (branch token): the system

stage_2_live.definitions: as rule-integration-v1 amendment 2: a trial is detected when any alarm of the arm falls inside [start, start + 15 s] on its container; alert time = earliest alarm; normal alarms of one container (pod_uid, container) merged into episodes when less than 15 s apart
stage_2_live.expectations: V3 primary: recall >= 95 %, precision >= 95 %, idle-control positive <= 5 %, p95 kernel -> first alarm (window end) <= 3 s; met = all four; Wilson 95 % CI
reported_without_threshold: benign-exec control flagged (share of benign binaries alarmed), per arm

alarm burden: episodes per replica-hour over selection end -> capture end without the campaign span, workload-clustered bootstrap 95 % CI, per arm, beside pulse-final-system-confirm (1.76 with the replica gate, 5.60 without)
recall by attack rate and by scenario, per arm
token scoring latency (token_scored_at - window_end) and frame lag p50 / p95 / p99 / max per worker
worker CPU and memory, tokens.jsonl volume
stage_2_live.after: exec-intent is decided on this run's benign-binary share; then the comparison with rules; LID-DS 2019 last

order: stage 1 and stage 2 never overlap ablation stage 2 (syscall-loo-stage2) or any other heavy job on any node; stage 2 starts only after the stage-1 fit is frozen
limits: the count branches score only windows the frozen candidate scores (its history requirement stays; lidds-ml-v3 lifted the warm-up gate offline)
thresholds are per workload from one 4 h validation span; drift over the 24 h live run is not refitted
the token alphabet and the errno list were chosen on LID-DS development with attack labels; this run and LID-DS 2019 are the independent evidence
code: sentinel_pulse/pipeline/plan_matched_run.py --token-build --token-models --v3-counts, pipeline/matched_worker.py (cfg tokens, v3_counts), detector/token_model.py, detector/v3_policy.py, collector/token_capture.py
